description_en: Creates a root certificate authority (CA) certificate
kebab_example: aliyun cas create-root-ca-certificate --common-name Alibaba --organization-unit Security --organization Aliyun --locality Hangzhou --state Zhejiang --country-code CN --algorithm RSA_2048 --years 10 --client-token 3838B684-3075-582B-9A45-8C99104029DF --tags Value=1 Key=runtime --resource-group-id rg-aek0000wia --api-version 2020-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRootCACertificate

parameters.help_en: The common name or abbreviation of the organization. Supports Chinese characters and letters
parameters.help_zh: 组织机构的通用名称或简称。支持使用中文、英文字符等
parameters.name: common_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the department or branch in the organization. Supports Chinese characters and letters
parameters.help_zh: 组织机构下部门或分支的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等
parameters.name: organization_unit

parameters.help_en: The name of the organization for the root CA certificate. This is typically your company or enterprise name. Supports Chinese characters and letters
parameters.help_zh: 根CA证书关联的组织机构（对应您的企业或单位）的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等
parameters.name: organization

parameters.help_en: The name of the city where the organization is located. Supports Chinese characters and letters
parameters.help_zh: 组织机构所在城市的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等
parameters.name: locality

parameters.help_en: <props="intl">The name of the province or state where the organization is located. Supports Chinese characters and letters.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等。</props>
<props="intl">组织机构所在省份或州的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等。</props>
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The two-letter uppercase code of the country or region where the organization is located. For example, **CN** indicates China and **US** indicates the United States.

For more information about country codes, see the **Country codes** section in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html
parameters.help_zh:
组织机构所在国家或地区的代码，使用两位大写英文字母缩写表示。例如，**CN**表示中国，**US**表示美国。

关于不同国家的代码，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html中的**国际代号**章节
parameters.name: country_code

parameters.help_en:
The key algorithm of the root CA certificate. The key algorithm is in the `<encryption algorithm>_<key length>` format. Valid values:

- **RSA\_1024**: The corresponding signature algorithm is Sha256WithRSA.

- **RSA\_2048**: The corresponding signature algorithm is Sha256WithRSA.

- **RSA\_4096**: The corresponding signature algorithm is Sha256WithRSA.

- **ECC\_256**: The corresponding signature algorithm is Sha256WithECDSA.

- **ECC\_384**: The corresponding signature algorithm is Sha256WithECDSA.

- **ECC\_512**: The corresponding signature algorithm is Sha256WithECDSA.

- **SM2\_256**: The corresponding signature algorithm is SM3WithSM2.

The encryption algorithm of the root CA certificate must be the same as the **Certificate Algorithm** of the private root CA that you purchased. For example, if you set **Certificate Algorithm** to **RSA** when you purchase a private root CA, the key algorithm of the root CA certificate must be **RSA\_1024**, **RSA\_2048**, or **RSA\_4096**
parameters.help_zh:
根CA证书的密钥算法类型。密钥算法使用`<加密算法>_<密钥长度>`格式表示。取值：

- **RSA_1024**：对应签名算法为Sha256WithRSA。
- **RSA_2048**：对应签名算法为Sha256WithRSA。
- **RSA_4096**：对应签名算法为Sha256WithRSA。
- **ECC_256**：对应签名算法为Sha256WithECDSA。
- **ECC_384**：对应签名算法为Sha256WithECDSA。
- **ECC_512**：对应签名算法为Sha256WithECDSA。
- **SM2_256**：对应签名算法为SM3WithSM2。


根CA证书的加密算法必须与您购买的私有根CA的**证书算法**一致。示例：如果您购买私有根CA时选择的**证书算法**为**RSA**，则根CA证书的密钥算法必须是**RSA\_1024**、**RSA\_2048**或**RSA\_4096**
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the root CA certificate. Unit: years.

> Set the validity period to 5 to 10 years
parameters.help_zh:
根CA证书的有效期，单位：年。

> 建议设置为5~10年
parameters.name: years

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The token supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
